entries.zh: 背面相向；朝北（字面）〔西语词头与汉语栏不相应，义存疑〕
entries.en: back-to-back; facing north (literal)〔headword not matched by Chinese column; sense uncertain〕
entries.notes: L 欄「Denidado」非通行西語詞形，H 欄「北頭北面」亦非『大膽／無畏』之對譯，四欄不互證。

entries.zh: 先前、以前（西语 denantes）〔汉语栏作『使』，音写栏残缺，存疑〕
entries.en: before; previously (denantes)〔Chinese column '使' does not fit; phonetic column damaged〕
entries.notes: M 欄空白，R 欄「pymun」带截断符「⟩」，仅 L 欄可据；H「使」与西语义不合。

entries.zh: 岂（反问，表绝不）；决不、断无
entries.en: by no means; in no way (豈 used as rhetorical denial)
there is none at all; not any at all
entries.notes: M、R 兩欄均带 [疑] 标记，末尾 tō／foi 一音来源不明。

entries.en: none whatsoever; entirely without
how could there be any? — by no means
entries.notes: R 欄作 quỹ iēn，与 M 欄 quỹ iù 末音节不一致，取『岂有』为读。

entries.en: at night; by night
entries.notes: H 欄字形疑为『宵』而非『霄』，且 R 欄 viīn 与宵音不合，仅 L／M 两欄相合。

entries.en: 〔original damaged; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: 四欄皆标 [残]，无可据材料。

entries.en: inside; within
entries.notes: R 欄有 [残]、[疑] 杂记，然 H「内」与 L dentro 相符。

entries.en: inside; within; the inner part
inside a room; within (間)
entries.notes: H「間」唯就『室內』一义与 L dentro 相合，R 欄 guiēn 对音不稳。

entries.en: inside; the inner side
in the house; at home
within the kingdom; inside the realm
entries.notes: H 欄 [疑:閫内／國内]，依 L「Reyno」取『國內』义。

entries.en: in here; here inside
entries.notes: L 欄缩作「Dentro del R.」，所指（Reyno？）存疑；H 欄亦标 [疑]。

entries.zh: 〔此条原件已划除，汉语栏空白，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔entry struck out in the original; no Chinese given〕
entries.notes: H、M 两欄皆 [空]，全条被删除，仅存 R 欄残音 tzop chēⁿ nam。

entries.en: to denounce; to inform against (to the authorities)
entries.notes: M 欄仅一音节、R 欄重出「cīn: cīn」，对音依 H「首」（出首）推定。

entries.en: to inform against; to denounce to the authorities
to depend on; to belong to (係)
entries.notes: H 欄 [疑:係／流]，取『係』以合 depender／pertenecer 三义。

entries.en: to be up to; to depend on (someone's will)
entries.notes: L 欄「Bolutad」＝voluntad；R 欄 [疑:iēn/iū] 与 M 欄 iū 不一致。
